Alibaba to Sell Gaming Unit for Over $1.5 Billion

Alibaba Group is selling its gaming division for at least $1.5 billion as part of a corporate reorganisation. The move aims to divest non-core assets and focus on strategic priorities like AI and cloud computing. The company aims to achieve $100 billion in AI revenue within five years under CEO Eddie Wu's leadership.
